verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents full query logging for agent runs, with replay of exactly what was read down to the column. It also exposes the stock ClickHouse observability surface and a searchable per-execution stats table, which together cover the 'who ran what' audit half. Nothing documents column-level lineage tracing where data came from; column-level read logging is query auditing, not provenance lineage. Missing for 10: column-level data lineage/provenance, an explicit user-attributed audit log covering all principals (not just agents), independent or hands-on corroboration.
